lines.zh: 我一拳一拳地砸着地面挪动。
lines.en: I drag myself forward, pounding the floor with each fist.

lines.zh: 铁指节刮过下界砖，火星四溅。
lines.en: My iron knuckles scrape nether brick, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 我挪一步，竞技场就震一下。
lines.en: One step of mine shakes the whole arena.

lines.zh: 没有腿，我靠拳头走。
lines.en: No legs at all; my fists are how I walk.

lines.zh: 我碾过地上的碎骨。
lines.en: I grind the shattered bones under myself.

lines.zh: 熔岩在远处流，我朝那边挪。
lines.en: Lava flows far off and I shift toward it.

lines.zh: 我拖着沉重的影子走过看台。
lines.en: I drag my heavy shadow past the stands.

lines.zh: 每一次落地都扬起灰尘。
lines.en: Dust rises with every landing.

lines.zh: 我转过身，铁壳嘎吱作响。
lines.en: I turn, and my iron shell grinds aloud.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一千次了。
lines.en: I have crossed this path a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我攥紧又松开，指节咔咔响。
lines.en: I clench and unclench; my knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 竞技场很安静，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: The arena is quiet except for my breathing.

lines.zh: 铁壳里的热气慢慢散出来。
lines.en: Heat leaks slowly out of my iron shell.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，等着下一个对手。
lines.en: I hover in place, waiting for the next challenger.

lines.zh: 下界砖缝里长不出草。
lines.en: Nothing green grows between the nether bricks.

lines.zh: 我数着墙上的裂缝打发时间。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the wall to pass the time.

lines.zh: 我的影子比整座擂台还长。
lines.en: My shadow is longer than the entire ring.

lines.zh: 这拳套里的火，比岩浆烫。
lines.en: The fire in this gauntlet burns hotter than lava.

lines.zh: 我把自己擦得发亮，再等一会。
lines.en: I polish myself bright, then wait some more.

lines.zh: 没有人来，拳头也会寂寞。
lines.en: With nobody here, even fists get lonely.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个倒在这的人。
lines.en: I remember every single person who fell here.

lines.zh: 熔岩的光映在我的铁面上。
lines.en: Lava light plays across my iron face.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，关节有点涩。
lines.en: I try a fist and the joints feel stiff.

lines.zh: 擂台是我的，谁也拿不走。
lines.en: This arena is mine and nobody takes it.

lines.zh: 铁面上有一道旧划痕，我留着。
lines.en: There is an old gouge on my iron. I keep it.

lines.zh: 熔岩池冒泡，我数它破了几个。
lines.en: The lava bubbles. I count each burst.

lines.zh: 我张开的指缝，够你钻过去。
lines.en: The gaps between my fingers are wide enough for you.

lines.zh: 你站在我的拳影里。
lines.en: You are standing in the shadow of my fist.

lines.zh: 这么小的对手，也敢进来。
lines.en: Such a small challenger dares to step in.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪指节，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I tilt a knuckle by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我眼里很薄。
lines.en: Your armor looks thin to me.

lines.zh: 我看清你的站位了，别动。
lines.en: I have your position now; hold still.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑在抖。
lines.en: The sword in your hand is trembling.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的盾还大。
lines.en: My fist is larger than your shield.

lines.zh: 上一次有人这样看我，已很久。
lines.en: It has been long since anyone looked at me so.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear every one of your footsteps clearly.

lines.zh: 我抬起拳头，让你看清大小。
lines.en: I raise my fist so you can see its size.

lines.zh: 你这高度，只到我指节。
lines.en: You only reach my knuckle.

lines.zh: 铁壳凹了一块，我记住了。
lines.en: A dent in my shell; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 疼，但铁不会喊。
lines.en: It hurts, but iron does not cry out.

lines.zh: 我的指节裂了条缝。
lines.en: A crack has opened across my knuckle.

lines.zh: 我的拳套被打歪了。
lines.en: My gauntlet got knocked out of line.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，重新站稳。
lines.en: I sway, then plant myself again.

lines.zh: 你打中关节了，很聪明。
lines.en: You hit a joint; that was clever.

lines.zh: 铁屑落在地上，叮当响。
lines.en: Iron flakes fall and clink on the floor.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，只有半步。
lines.en: I give half a step, and only half.

lines.zh: 我的怒火更旺了。
lines.en: My fury burns hotter now.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换你一命够了。
lines.en: This wound is enough to buy your life.

lines.zh: 食物？我连嘴都没有。
lines.en: Food? I do not even have a mouth.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我只想打碎它。
lines.en: You hold something up; I only want to smash it.

lines.zh: 金子对拳头没有意义。
lines.en: Gold means nothing at all to a fist.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我不吃这一套。
lines.en: Put it away; that trick will not work on me.

lines.zh: 我的燃料是熔岩，不是面包。
lines.en: Lava is my fuel, not bread.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住一拳。
lines.en: Whatever you hold will not stop one punch.

lines.zh: 别拿食物换命，换不到。
lines.en: Do not trade food for your life; it will not work.

lines.zh: 我只对碰撞感兴趣。
lines.en: Only impacts interest me.

lines.zh: 你越晃，我越想砸。
lines.en: The more you wave it, the more I want to smash it.

lines.zh: 诱惑对铁壳没用。
lines.en: Temptation does nothing to an iron shell.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a solid wall.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，你退了三步。
lines.en: I do not budge; you fall back three steps.

lines.zh: 铁壳相碰，声音闷得吓人。
lines.en: Iron meets iron with a frighteningly dull thud.

lines.zh: 想推我？先练十年。
lines.en: Want to push me? Train another ten years.

lines.zh: 我稍微一侧，你就滑开了。
lines.en: I lean slightly and you slide right off.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我会本能挥拳。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; my fists swing by instinct.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的肩膀还好吗？
lines.en: After that bump, is your shoulder still fine?

lines.zh: 我的重量就是我的道理。
lines.en: My weight is my argument.

lines.zh: 你弹开的样子挺有意思。
lines.en: The way you bounce away is rather amusing.

lines.zh: 擂台边上有栏杆，小心。
lines.en: Mind the railing at the edge of the arena.

lines.zh: 拳头不需要伴侣。
lines.en: A fist needs no partner.

lines.zh: 我从石头里来，没有同类。
lines.en: I came out of stone; I have no kin.

lines.zh: 你想问繁殖？走错地方了。
lines.en: Asking about breeding? You have the wrong place.

lines.zh: 我的血脉只有铁与火。
lines.en: My bloodline is only iron and fire.

lines.zh: 两只拳头会互相砸碎。
lines.en: Two fists would only smash each other apart.

lines.zh: 这座擂台容不下第二个我。
lines.en: This arena cannot hold a second me.

lines.zh: 我不会留下后代，只留下坑。
lines.en: I leave no heirs behind, only craters.

lines.zh: 孤独是拳套的常态。
lines.en: Solitude is the normal state of a gauntlet.

lines.zh: 别在我面前谈成双成对。
lines.en: Do not talk of pairs in front of me.

lines.zh: 我生来就是一件兵器。
lines.en: I was made to be a weapon.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，我没有手指。
lines.en: I cannot pick anything up; I have no fingers.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，一脚就碾了。
lines.en: Whatever is on the floor, one press flattens it.

lines.zh: 我的拳头只做两件事：砸和握。
lines.en: My fists do two things only: smash and clench.

lines.zh: 掉落的战利品，我不屑去捡。
lines.en: I do not stoop to gather dropped loot.

lines.zh: 你想要？那你自己捡。
lines.en: You want it? Then pick it up yourself.

lines.zh: 拳头一张，东西就碎了。
lines.en: Once the fist opens, the thing crumbles.

lines.zh: 我的收藏只有伤疤。
lines.en: My only collection is scars.

lines.zh: 那枚金币在我脚下发亮。
lines.en: That coin glints beneath my foot.

lines.zh: 我不需要带着东西走路。
lines.en: I do not need to carry anything while I move.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，别在我眼前晃。
lines.en: Take it away; do not dangle it near me.

lines.zh: 你踏进圈内，就算开战了。
lines.en: Step into the ring and the fight has begun.

lines.zh: 铁拳握紧，竞技场关门。
lines.en: The iron fist closes; the arena shuts.

lines.zh: 铁指节指向你，就是判决。
lines.en: An iron knuckle pointed at you is a verdict.

lines.zh: 我等这一刻很久了。
lines.en: I have waited a long time for this moment.

lines.zh: 你的名字不重要，位置重要。
lines.en: Your name is irrelevant; your position is not.

lines.zh: 擂台的规矩：进来就得打。
lines.en: Arena law: enter, and you fight.

lines.zh: 你踏进熔岩光里，我就盯上了。
lines.en: You step into the lava glow, and I have you.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后面。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the pillars.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我就堵住你。
lines.en: Back to the wall, and I will pin you there.

lines.zh: 挑战者，我乐意接受。
lines.en: Challenger, I accept your challenge gladly.

lines.zh: 我的怒火从熔岩里烧起来。
lines.en: My fury rises burning out of the lava.

lines.zh: 这一场，只有一个能走出去。
lines.en: Only one of us walks out of this match.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是恐惧。
lines.en: The smell coming off you is fear.

lines.zh: 战鼓还没响，我已经准备好了。
lines.en: The drum has not sounded, yet I am ready.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在砖上，我听见了。
lines.en: Your steps on the brick. I heard them.

lines.zh: 你带了帮手，一起进来也行。
lines.en: You brought friends. Come in together.

lines.zh: 门关上了，现在你归我管。
lines.en: The gate is shut. You are mine now.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的剑，太细了。
lines.en: I look at your sword. Too thin.

lines.zh: 我抬起拳头，瞄准你的胸口。
lines.en: I raise my fist, aiming at your chest.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的拳就往左。
lines.en: You go left, and my fist follows left.

lines.zh: 我在等你挥空的那一秒。
lines.en: I am waiting for the second your swing goes wide.

lines.zh: 指节收紧，发出金属声。
lines.en: My knuckles tighten with a metal rasp.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住一下，挡不住三下。
lines.en: Your shield stops one blow, not three.

lines.zh: 我压低身形，准备旋起来。
lines.en: I lower myself, ready to start spinning.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，不是犹豫。
lines.en: I am measuring distance, not hesitating.

lines.zh: 你每次挪步，拳影都跟着移。
lines.en: Every step you take, my fist shadow follows.

lines.zh: 再近一步，就够了。
lines.en: One more step and it will be enough.

lines.zh: 我用余光盯着你的副手。
lines.en: I watch your off hand from the corner of my eye.

lines.zh: 光在拳缝里聚起来了。
lines.en: Light is gathering between my knuckles.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，那就打肚子。
lines.en: You raise a hand to guard your face, so I take your gut.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比这场地还厚。
lines.en: My patience is thicker than this arena.

lines.zh: 激光在拳心里转，瞄准你了。
lines.en: The laser spins in my palm, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我横过整块场地，堵你的路。
lines.en: I cross the whole floor to cut you off.

lines.zh: 你跳到台阶上，我照样够到。
lines.en: Jump to the steps. I still reach.

lines.zh: 我转起拳来，整个擂台都在扫。
lines.en: I spin my fist. The arena sweeps.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里先软。
lines.en: I watch your knees. They give first.

lines.zh: 你的火抗药水挡不住铁。
lines.en: Your fire potion will not stop iron.

lines.zh: 我停半秒，让你以为有机会。
lines.en: I pause half a beat. Think you have a chance.

lines.zh: 正面一拳，接好了！
lines.en: A straight punch — take it well!

lines.zh: 我旋转起来，拳风扫一整圈。
lines.en: I spin and my fist sweeps the whole circle.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在你脚边，地裂了。
lines.en: This one lands by your feet and the floor cracks.

lines.zh: 铁碰骨头，声音很脆。
lines.en: Iron meets bone with a crisp little sound.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞在看台上。
lines.en: You fly off and crash into the stands.

lines.zh: 旋拳还没停，站稳了。
lines.en: The spin punch is not done; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 我打空了，但风压也够疼。
lines.en: I miss, but the wind alone hurts enough.

lines.zh: 两拳连击，别只防一边。
lines.en: Two fists in a row; do not guard only one side.

lines.zh: 你的护甲凹进去了。
lines.en: Your armor has a dent in it now.

lines.zh: 这一拳我留了力，下一拳不会。
lines.en: I held back on this one; the next I will not.

lines.zh: 打到你了，手感不错。
lines.en: I hit you, and that felt good.

lines.zh: 别退，退了也会被我追上。
lines.en: Do not retreat; I will catch you anyway.

lines.zh: 拳头比你的剑快。
lines.en: My fist is faster than your sword.

lines.zh: 站起来，我还没尽兴。
lines.en: Get up; I am not finished enjoying this.

lines.zh: 竞技场的封印裂了。
lines.en: The seal on the arena has cracked.

lines.zh: 铁拳从地砖下升起。
lines.en: An iron fist rises up through the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 我醒来了，地板在颤。
lines.en: I am awake, and the floor is trembling.

lines.zh: 下界砖一块块被顶开。
lines.en: Nether bricks are pushed aside one by one.

lines.zh: 很久没人来挑战了。
lines.en: No one has come to challenge me in ages.

lines.zh: 我的指节先着地，然后是怒火。
lines.en: First my knuckles land, then my fury.

lines.zh: 熔岩为我照亮了擂台。
lines.en: Lava lights the arena for me.

lines.zh: 这场地记得我的重量。
lines.en: This ground remembers my weight.

lines.zh: 我伸展铁臂，屋顶都在响。
lines.en: I stretch my iron arms and the roof groans.

lines.zh: 挑战者会自己找上门。
lines.en: Challengers find their own way to my door.

lines.zh: 我把灰尘抖落，露出旧疤。
lines.en: I shake off the dust and show my old scars.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里重新开赛。
lines.en: As of today, this arena reopens for a match.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整片地砖。
lines.en: My shadow covers every tile of the floor.

lines.zh: 谁敢先踏进来？
lines.en: Who dares to step in first?

lines.zh: 熔炉的火忽然全往这边倒。
lines.en: The forge fire suddenly leans this way.

lines.zh: 我先把一只拳放上地面。
lines.en: I set one fist on the floor first.

lines.zh: 铁链绷断，我从台下起来。
lines.en: Chains snap. I rise from under the floor.

lines.zh: 下界的空气开始发烫，我到了。
lines.en: The nether air turns hot. I have arrived.

lines.zh: 擂台四角亮起，我算开场。
lines.en: The four corners light. That is the bell.

lines.zh: 我抖掉肩上的灰，很大一片。
lines.en: I shake the dust off my shoulder. A wide patch.

lines.zh: 火烧不掉铁，只让它发烫。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn iron, only heat it up.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，自己更疼。
lines.en: Crashing down from above hurts me more than you.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节，转起来发涩。
lines.en: Water in my joints makes them grind.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推开了几格。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back a few blocks.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的铁缝里。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my iron seam.

lines.zh: 咒文缠住我，铁臂抬不起来。
lines.en: Spells bind me and my iron arms will not lift.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越钝。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only grow duller.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，火花四散。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and sparks fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我，我抓紧了地基。
lines.en: The void pulls at me; I grip the foundation.
